# Seagö

> Seagö is an Indian marine mobility manufacturer engineering high-efficiency electric outboard motors (3–50 HP), marine LiFePO4 battery packs, and custom electric & solar watercraft for India's inland waterways and coastlines.

Seagö operates an integrated design, engineering, and manufacturing facility in Chennai, Tamil Nadu, paired with a sales, support, and field-service headquarters in Kerala. Field-proven across 5 Indian states (Tamil Nadu, Karnataka, Kerala, Maharashtra, and Odisha), Seagö provides zero-emission, low-maintenance propulsion systems tailored for commercial fishing vessels, eco-tourism boats, passenger ferries, and custom institutional watercraft.

## Core Pages

- [Seagö Home](https://seago.in/index.html): Overview of zero-emission electric outboards and vessels, key performance metrics, and complete fleet electrification systems.
- [About Seagö & Leadership](https://seago.in/about.html): Company history, Chennai manufacturing facility, Kerala sales base, and executive leadership by Founder & CEO Gopish Kumar G.
- [Products](https://seago.in/products.html): Comprehensive catalog of 3 HP to 50 HP electric outboards, marine-grade LiFePO4 battery packs, and custom FRP solar/electric vessels.
- [Case Studies & Deployments](https://seago.in/case-studies.html): Operational field reports including Vikalpika (India's 1st electric fishing vessel with ICAR-CIFT), Karnataka tourism fleets, Kerala public ferries, and IMU hydrogen fuel-cell research.
- [Visual Gallery](https://seago.in/gallery.html): Field footage, video recordings of trial runs across backwaters and rivers, vessel walk-arounds, and motor photography.
- [Contact & Quote Inquiries](https://seago.in/contact.html): Quote request form, direct email (sales@seago.in), WhatsApp hotline (+91 86063 66633), and office locations in Kerala and Chennai.

## Electric Outboard Motors (3 HP to 50 HP)

Seagö engineers 8 electric outboard models utilizing high-torque Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors (PMSM) or brushless motor architectures, magnetic encoder precision sensing, and robust cooling systems:

- [SEAGÖ 3 HP](https://seago.in/products.html#outboard): 2.2 kW rated power, 51.2V, 4500–5000 RPM, air-cooled, tiller control, suitable for 2–4 m boats. Paired with 51.2V 50Ah LiFePO4 battery.
- [SEAGÖ 7 HP](https://seago.in/products.html#outboard): 5.1 kW rated power, 51.2V, 5000–5500 RPM, water-cooled, forward/neutral/reverse gear, tiller control, suitable for 2–4 m boats. Paired with 51.2V 105Ah LiFePO4 battery.
- [SEAGÖ 10 HP](https://seago.in/products.html#outboard): 7.3 kW rated power, 73.6V, 4250 RPM, water-cooled, tiller or remote steering, suitable for 3–6 m boats. Paired with 73.6V 150Ah LiFePO4 battery.
- [SEAGÖ 15 HP](https://seago.in/products.html#outboard): 11 kW rated power, 73.6V, 4650–4700 RPM, water-cooled, tiller or remote steering, suitable for 3.6–7 m boats. Paired with 73.6V 210Ah LiFePO4 battery.
- [SEAGÖ 20 HP](https://seago.in/products.html#outboard): 15 kW rated power, 96V, 5800 RPM, water-cooled, tiller or remote steering, suitable for 3.6–7 m boats. Paired with 96V 210Ah LiFePO4 battery.
- [SEAGÖ 30 HP](https://seago.in/products.html#outboard): 22 kW rated power, 96V, 5800 RPM, water-cooled PMSM, infinitely variable speed control, suitable for boats 4 m and above. Paired with 96V 230Ah LiFePO4 battery.
- [SEAGÖ 40 HP](https://seago.in/products.html#outboard): 29.4 kW rated power, 144V, 5000–6000 RPM, water-cooled, steering grip or wheel controls, suitable for boats 4 m and above. Paired with 144V 200Ah LiFePO4 battery.
- [SEAGÖ 50 HP](https://seago.in/products.html#outboard): 37.2 kW rated power, 144V, 5500 RPM, water-cooled brushless motor, steering grip or wheel controls, suitable for boats 4 m and above. Paired with 144V 300Ah LiFePO4 battery.

## Marine LiFePO4 Battery Systems

- [LiFePO4 Marine Battery Packs](https://seago.in/products.html#battery): Stable, high-cycle Lithium Iron Phosphate chemistry with integrated intelligent Battery Management System (BMS).
- Voltage ratings: 51.2V, 73.6V, 96V, and 144V DC configurations.
- Capacity range: 50 Ah to 400 Ah.
- Enclosure: Marine-grade IP-rated sealed enclosures resistant to vibration, high humidity, and saltwater corrosion. Built for shore charging and solar-hybrid top-up.

## Custom Electric & Solar-Powered Boats

- [Custom Watercraft Builds](https://seago.in/products.html#boats): Built on high-grade Fibre-Reinforced Plastic (FRP) composite hulls tailored for specific commercial missions.
- Applications: Eco-tourism boats, inland passenger ferries, artisanal and commercial fishing boats.
- Solar Integration: Solar canopies for continuous auxiliary charging and extended operating range.
- Full turnkey delivery: Manufactured, assembled, fitted with propulsion, and water-tested in Chennai prior to delivery.

## Field Case Studies & Institutional Provenance

- [Vikalpika Electric Fishing Vessel](https://seago.in/case-studies.html#vikalpika): India's first electric fishing vessel, developed in partnership with ICAR-CIFT Mumbai (launched May 2025 in Maharashtra), demonstrating heavy-duty commercial duty cycles without diesel exhaust or fuel expense.
- [Public Water Transport Ferries](https://seago.in/case-studies.html#public-transport): Clean, near-silent passenger ferry propulsion operating on daily commuter routes across Kerala waterways.
- [Karnataka Eco-Tourism Fleets](https://seago.in/case-studies.html#tourism): Electric passenger craft operating in eco-sensitive and heritage locations including Hampi, Hubli, Gadag, Bagalkot, and Honnavar.
- [Hydrogen Fuel-Cell Research Vessel](https://seago.in/case-studies.html#hydrogen): Completed pioneering marine R&D programme in collaboration with Indian Maritime University (IMU) evaluating next-generation alternative marine energy carriers.
